title: We just shipped support for the ugliest part of HTTP: Vary

paragraphs.en: The response header, Vary , has been called “ the ugliest part of HTTP that we haven't yet improved. ” The same post describes it as a “horrible, kludgy mechanism” with “pretty abysmal interoperability” across intermediaries. That is usually where sensible engineers back away slowly with their hands raised.
paragraphs.zh: 响应头 Vary 被称为「HTTP 中我们尚未改进的最丑陋的部分」。同一篇文章将其描述为一种「糟糕、拙劣的机制」，在各个中间节点之间的「互操作性相当差」。 这通常就是明智的工程师们举起双手慢慢后退离开的地方。

sents.en: The response header, Vary , has been called “ the ugliest part of HTTP that we haven't yet improved. ” The same post describes it as a “horrible, kludgy mechanism” with “pretty abysmal interoperability” across intermediaries.
sents.zh: 响应头 Vary 被称为「HTTP 中我们尚未改进的最丑陋的部分」。同一篇文章将其描述为一种「糟糕、拙劣的机制」，在各个中间节点之间的「互操作性相当差」。

sents.en: That is usually where sensible engineers back away slowly with their hands raised.
sents.zh: 这通常就是明智的工程师们举起双手慢慢后退离开的地方。

paragraphs.en: That’s not exactly an endorsement of Vary , but ugly doesn’t mean useless.
paragraphs.zh: 这算不上是对 Vary 的认可，但丑并不意味着无用。

paragraphs.en: One URL can have more than one correct response. A server might, for example, deliver different image formats to different browsers. If a cache ignores Vary , it risks serving the wrong bytes to a request. But if it treats every raw header value as distinct, a handful of similar requests can spread into thousands of barely reusable cache entries. Vary tells a cache which request fields may affect the response, but it does not tell the cache which differences actually matter.
paragraphs.zh: 一个 URL 可以有多个正确的响应。 例如，服务器可能向不同的浏览器提供不同的图像格式。 如果缓存忽略 Vary，就有向请求提供错误字节的风险。 但如果它把每个原始头字段值都视为不同的，少量相似的请求就可能扩散成数千个几乎无法复用的缓存条目。 Vary 告诉缓存哪些请求字段可能影响响应，但它并没有告诉缓存哪些差异才是真正重要的。

sents.en: One URL can have more than one correct response.
sents.zh: 一个 URL 可以有多个正确的响应。

sents.en: A server might, for example, deliver different image formats to different browsers.
sents.zh: 例如，服务器可能向不同的浏览器提供不同的图像格式。

sents.en: If a cache ignores Vary , it risks serving the wrong bytes to a request.
sents.zh: 如果缓存忽略 Vary，就有向请求提供错误字节的风险。

sents.en: But if it treats every raw header value as distinct, a handful of similar requests can spread into thousands of barely reusable cache entries.
sents.zh: 但如果它把每个原始头字段值都视为不同的，少量相似的请求就可能扩散成数千个几乎无法复用的缓存条目。

sents.en: Vary tells a cache which request fields may affect the response, but it does not tell the cache which differences actually matter.
sents.zh: Vary 告诉缓存哪些请求字段可能影响响应，但它并没有告诉缓存哪些差异才是真正重要的。

paragraphs.en: Vary support is now available in Cache Rules on every plan. The origin still names the request headers that may affect a response, but you decide how Cloudflare handles each one. You can normalize known negotiation headers, pass exact values through when those small differences matter, or bypass cache when the variation is too unpredictable. The origin declares what may vary, and you decide how much variation is actually meaningful for the cache.
paragraphs.zh: 所有套餐的缓存规则（Cache Rules）现已支持 Vary。 源服务器仍然会指明可能影响响应的请求头，但由您决定 Cloudflare 如何处理每一个请求头。 您可以对已知的协商请求头进行规范化处理，在这些细微差异很重要时原样传递精确值，或者在变化过于不可预测时绕过缓存。 源服务器声明可能存在哪些变化，而由您决定哪些变化实际上对缓存有意义。

sents.en: Vary support is now available in Cache Rules on every plan.
sents.zh: 所有套餐的缓存规则（Cache Rules）现已支持 Vary。

sents.en: The origin still names the request headers that may affect a response, but you decide how Cloudflare handles each one.
sents.zh: 源服务器仍然会指明可能影响响应的请求头，但由您决定 Cloudflare 如何处理每一个请求头。

sents.en: You can normalize known negotiation headers, pass exact values through when those small differences matter, or bypass cache when the variation is too unpredictable.
sents.zh: 您可以对已知的协商请求头进行规范化处理，在这些细微差异很重要时原样传递精确值，或者在变化过于不可预测时绕过缓存。

sents.en: The origin declares what may vary, and you decide how much variation is actually meaningful for the cache.
sents.zh: 源服务器声明可能存在哪些变化，而由您决定哪些变化实际上对缓存有意义。

paragraphs.en: Vary is a standard HTTP response header that tells intermediary caches (like Cloudflare) which request fields may affect the response sent by the origin. Sites use Vary to serve different languages, image formats, compression schemes, or regional content from the same URL.
paragraphs.zh: Vary 是一个标准的 HTTP 响应头，用于告知中间缓存（如 Cloudflare）哪些请求字段可能会影响源站返回的响应。 网站使用 Vary 来通过同一个 URL 提供不同语言、图像格式、压缩方案或区域内容。

sents.en: Vary is a standard HTTP response header that tells intermediary caches (like Cloudflare) which request fields may affect the response sent by the origin.
sents.zh: Vary 是一个标准的 HTTP 响应头，用于告知中间缓存（如 Cloudflare）哪些请求字段可能会影响源站返回的响应。

sents.en: Sites use Vary to serve different languages, image formats, compression schemes, or regional content from the same URL.
sents.zh: 网站使用 Vary 来通过同一个 URL 提供不同语言、图像格式、压缩方案或区域内容。

paragraphs.en: Take one URL that produces two valid representations. A browser requests a webpage:
paragraphs.zh: 取一个能生成两种有效表示的 URL。 浏览器请求一个网页：

sents.en: Take one URL that produces two valid representations.
sents.zh: 取一个能生成两种有效表示的 URL。

sents.en: A browser requests a webpage:
sents.zh: 浏览器请求一个网页：

paragraphs.en: GET /catalog HTTP/1.1 Host: example.com Accept: text/html The origin returns HTML and identifies Accept as a field that may affect the response:
paragraphs.zh: GET /catalog HTTP/1.1 Host: example.com Accept: text/html 源服务器返回 HTML，并将 Accept 标识为可能影响响应的字段：

paragraphs.en: HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: text/html Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600 Vary: Accept An API client can request the same URL with a different preference:
paragraphs.zh: HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: text/html Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600 Vary: Accept API 客户端可以带不同的偏好请求同一个 URL：

paragraphs.en: GET /catalog HTTP/1.1 Host: example.com Accept: application/json This time, the correct response is JSON. The Vary: Accept header tells the cache that the URL alone is not enough to choose between responses. The request’s Accept value must also be considered.
paragraphs.zh: GET /catalog HTTP/1.1 Host: example.com Accept: application/json 这次，正确的响应是 JSON。 Vary: Accept 头告诉缓存：仅凭 URL 不足以在多个响应之间做出选择。 还必须考虑请求的 Accept 值。

sents.en: GET /catalog HTTP/1.1 Host: example.com Accept: application/json This time, the correct response is JSON.
sents.zh: GET /catalog HTTP/1.1 Host: example.com Accept: application/json 这次，正确的响应是 JSON。

sents.en: The Vary: Accept header tells the cache that the URL alone is not enough to choose between responses.
sents.zh: Vary: Accept 头告诉缓存：仅凭 URL 不足以在多个响应之间做出选择。

sents.en: The request’s Accept value must also be considered.
sents.zh: 还必须考虑请求的 Accept 值。

paragraphs.en: Without Vary , whichever response enters the cache first can be served to both clients. If HTML wins, the API client receives markup and its JSON parser fails. If JSON wins, a browser expecting a web page receives an API response.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有 Vary 的情况下，无论哪个响应先进入缓存，都可能被同时提供给两个客户端。 如果 HTML 响应先进入，API 客户端会收到标记语言内容，其 JSON 解析器会解析失败。 如果 JSON 响应先进入，期待网页的浏览器会收到一个 API 响应。

sents.en: Without Vary , whichever response enters the cache first can be served to both clients.
sents.zh: 在没有 Vary 的情况下，无论哪个响应先进入缓存，都可能被同时提供给两个客户端。

sents.en: If HTML wins, the API client receives markup and its JSON parser fails.
sents.zh: 如果 HTML 响应先进入，API 客户端会收到标记语言内容，其 JSON 解析器会解析失败。

sents.en: If JSON wins, a browser expecting a web page receives an API response.
sents.zh: 如果 JSON 响应先进入，期待网页的浏览器会收到一个 API 响应。

paragraphs.en: Vary prevents the cache from serving the wrong response to the requesting client. But it introduces a harder question: when two requests contain different header values, do they actually need different responses?
paragraphs.zh: Vary 可防止缓存向请求的客户端返回错误的响应。 但它引入了一个更难的问题：当两个请求包含不同的头部值时，它们是否真的需要不同的响应？

sents.en: Vary prevents the cache from serving the wrong response to the requesting client.
sents.zh: Vary 可防止缓存向请求的客户端返回错误的响应。

sents.en: But it introduces a harder question: when two requests contain different header values, do they actually need different responses?
sents.zh: 但它引入了一个更难的问题：当两个请求包含不同的头部值时，它们是否真的需要不同的响应？

paragraphs.en: Vary can tell a cache which request fields may affect a response. It does not tell the cache what the response represents. For example, take an origin that serves content in only English, French, and German. A client might send:
paragraphs.zh: Vary 可以告诉缓存哪些请求字段可能会影响响应。 它不会告诉缓存该响应表示什么。 例如，假设一个源服务器只提供英语、法语和德语内容。客户端可能会发送：

sents.en: Vary can tell a cache which request fields may affect a response.
sents.zh: Vary 可以告诉缓存哪些请求字段可能会影响响应。

sents.en: It does not tell the cache what the response represents.
sents.zh: 它不会告诉缓存该响应表示什么。

sents.en: For example, take an origin that serves content in only English, French, and German. A client might send:
sents.zh: 例如，假设一个源服务器只提供英语、法语和德语内容。客户端可能会发送：

paragraphs.en: Accept-Language: en-US, fr;q=0.8 While another client might request:
paragraphs.zh: Accept-Language: en-US, fr;q=0.8 而另一个客户端可能会请求：

paragraphs.en: Accept-Language: fr;q=0.8, en-GB Both requests prefer English here. The origin’s response may map both requests to exactly the same English response. But a cache comparing the raw values cannot safely assume they are equivalent. They have different orders and language tags (that the origin doesn’t differentiate). So the cache may store them as separate variants, even when their response bodies contain identical bytes.
paragraphs.zh: Accept-Language: fr;q=0.8, en-GB 这两个请求在此处都偏好英语。 源服务器的响应可能把这两个请求映射为完全相同的英语响应。 但比较原始值的缓存不能安全地假定它们是等价的。 它们的顺序和语言标签不同（而源服务器并不对此加以区分）。 因此，即使它们的响应体包含完全相同的字节，缓存也可能将它们存储为不同的变体。

sents.en: Accept-Language: fr;q=0.8, en-GB Both requests prefer English here.
sents.zh: Accept-Language: fr;q=0.8, en-GB 这两个请求在此处都偏好英语。

sents.en: The origin’s response may map both requests to exactly the same English response.
sents.zh: 源服务器的响应可能把这两个请求映射为完全相同的英语响应。

sents.en: But a cache comparing the raw values cannot safely assume they are equivalent.
sents.zh: 但比较原始值的缓存不能安全地假定它们是等价的。

sents.en: They have different orders and language tags (that the origin doesn’t differentiate).
sents.zh: 它们的顺序和语言标签不同（而源服务器并不对此加以区分）。

sents.en: So the cache may store them as separate variants, even when their response bodies contain identical bytes.
sents.zh: 因此，即使它们的响应体包含完全相同的字节，缓存也可能将它们存储为不同的变体。

paragraphs.en: This is Vary ’s central problem. Applications often produce a small, finite set of representations from an enormous set of possible request values. The origin understands that thousands of language preferences collapse into three supported languages, while a cache usually does not.
paragraphs.zh: 这是 Vary 的核心问题。 应用程序通常会从海量的可能请求值中产生一个小型的、有限的表示集合。 源服务器明白数千种语言偏好会归类为三种受支持的语言，而缓存通常不明白这一点。

sents.en: This is Vary ’s central problem.
sents.zh: 这是 Vary 的核心问题。

sents.en: Applications often produce a small, finite set of representations from an enormous set of possible request values.
sents.zh: 应用程序通常会从海量的可能请求值中产生一个小型的、有限的表示集合。

sents.en: The origin understands that thousands of language preferences collapse into three supported languages, while a cache usually does not.
sents.zh: 源服务器明白数千种语言偏好会归类为三种受支持的语言，而缓存通常不明白这一点。

paragraphs.en: This problem compounds when a response varies on multiple fields. Ten possible values across one field create ten variants. Ten values across three fields can create 1,000 combinations. Real headers can have far greater cardinality: User-Agent values are numerous, cookies can be unique to individual visitors, and preference headers can differ in ordering, formatting (spaces and tabs matter!), and quality values .
paragraphs.zh: 当响应在多个字段上存在差异时，这个问题会进一步加剧。 单个字段上的十个可能取值会产生十个变体。 三个字段各十个取值可以产生 1,000 种组合。 真实的请求头可能具有更高的基数：User-Agent 的取值数量庞大，Cookie 可能对每个访客都是唯一的，而偏好头的顺序、格式（空格和制表符都很重要！）以及质量值都可能各不相同。

sents.en: This problem compounds when a response varies on multiple fields.
sents.zh: 当响应在多个字段上存在差异时，这个问题会进一步加剧。

sents.en: Ten possible values across one field create ten variants.
sents.zh: 单个字段上的十个可能取值会产生十个变体。

sents.en: Ten values across three fields can create 1,000 combinations.
sents.zh: 三个字段各十个取值可以产生 1,000 种组合。

sents.en: Real headers can have far greater cardinality: User-Agent values are numerous, cookies can be unique to individual visitors, and preference headers can differ in ordering, formatting (spaces and tabs matter!), and quality values .
sents.zh: 真实的请求头可能具有更高的基数：User-Agent 的取值数量庞大，Cookie 可能对每个访客都是唯一的，而偏好头的顺序、格式（空格和制表符都很重要！）以及质量值都可能各不相同。

paragraphs.en: The result is a cache that can be perfectly correct and almost permanently cold (an entry never reused). Identical responses can be scattered across entries that receive too little traffic to remain hot and in cache. They can consume capacity, evict one another, reduce cache hit ratios, and send more requests back to origin servers. Eviction can remove cold entries, but it cannot merge them just because the responses are identical.
paragraphs.zh: 结果就是一个可能完全正确却几乎永远处于冷态（条目从不被复用）的缓存。 相同的响应可能散布在多个条目中，这些条目的流量太少，无法保持热度并留在缓存中。 它们会占用容量、相互驱逐、降低缓存命中率，并把更多请求发回源服务器。 驱逐可以移除冷条目，但仅因为响应相同它并不能将它们合并。

sents.en: The result is a cache that can be perfectly correct and almost permanently cold (an entry never reused).
sents.zh: 结果就是一个可能完全正确却几乎永远处于冷态（条目从不被复用）的缓存。

sents.en: Identical responses can be scattered across entries that receive too little traffic to remain hot and in cache.
sents.zh: 相同的响应可能散布在多个条目中，这些条目的流量太少，无法保持热度并留在缓存中。

sents.en: They can consume capacity, evict one another, reduce cache hit ratios, and send more requests back to origin servers.
sents.zh: 它们会占用容量、相互驱逐、降低缓存命中率，并把更多请求发回源服务器。

sents.en: Eviction can remove cold entries, but it cannot merge them just because the responses are identical.
sents.zh: 驱逐可以移除冷条目，但仅因为响应相同它并不能将它们合并。

paragraphs.en: An analysis of more than 120 million responses from nearly 50,000 popular sites found almost 3,000 sites varying on four or more fields. Some varied on 10, 23, or even 47 fields. We want to make sure that customers have the tools they need to use Vary when appropriate, but not so much that they create a useless cache.
paragraphs.zh: 一项分析了来自近 50,000 个热门网站的超过 1.2 亿条响应的研究发现，近 3,000 个网站在四个或更多字段上存在差异（Vary）。 有些网站甚至在 10 个、23 个，甚至 47 个字段上存在差异。 我们希望确保客户拥有必要的工具，能在合适的情况下使用 Vary，但工具又不能多到让他们创建出无用的缓存。

sents.en: An analysis of more than 120 million responses from nearly 50,000 popular sites found almost 3,000 sites varying on four or more fields.
sents.zh: 一项分析了来自近 50,000 个热门网站的超过 1.2 亿条响应的研究发现，近 3,000 个网站在四个或更多字段上存在差异（Vary）。

sents.en: Some varied on 10, 23, or even 47 fields.
sents.zh: 有些网站甚至在 10 个、23 个，甚至 47 个字段上存在差异。

sents.en: We want to make sure that customers have the tools they need to use Vary when appropriate, but not so much that they create a useless cache.
sents.zh: 我们希望确保客户拥有必要的工具，能在合适的情况下使用 Vary，但工具又不能多到让他们创建出无用的缓存。

paragraphs.en: Some high-cardinality variation is deliberate. CDNs or reverse proxies may inject values, such as a geographic region, to partition content predictably. That works when the possible values are controlled and every component agrees on their meaning. Without those constraints, the cache fragments into variants it may never reuse.
paragraphs.zh: 某些高基数的差异是刻意为之的。 CDN 或反向代理可能会注入某些值，例如地理区域，以便可预测地划分内容。 当可能的值是受控的、并且所有组件对其含义达成一致时，这种做法才有效。 缺乏这些约束时，缓存就会碎片化成可能永远无法复用的变体。

sents.en: Some high-cardinality variation is deliberate.
sents.zh: 某些高基数的差异是刻意为之的。

sents.en: CDNs or reverse proxies may inject values, such as a geographic region, to partition content predictably.
sents.zh: CDN 或反向代理可能会注入某些值，例如地理区域，以便可预测地划分内容。

sents.en: That works when the possible values are controlled and every component agrees on their meaning.
sents.zh: 当可能的值是受控的、并且所有组件对其含义达成一致时，这种做法才有效。

sents.en: Without those constraints, the cache fragments into variants it may never reuse.
sents.zh: 缺乏这些约束时，缓存就会碎片化成可能永远无法复用的变体。

paragraphs.en: That was the design problem we needed to solve to support Vary . We needed to preserve enough variation to serve the right response, without allowing incidental differences between requests to destroy cache efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是我们需要解决的、用于支持 Vary 的设计问题。 我们需要保留足够的变化信息以便返回正确的响应，同时又不让请求之间偶然存在的差异破坏缓存效率。

sents.en: That was the design problem we needed to solve to support Vary .
sents.zh: 这就是我们需要解决的、用于支持 Vary 的设计问题。

sents.en: We needed to preserve enough variation to serve the right response, without allowing incidental differences between requests to destroy cache efficiency.
sents.zh: 我们需要保留足够的变化信息以便返回正确的响应，同时又不让请求之间偶然存在的差异破坏缓存效率。

paragraphs.en: Cloudflare customers already had several ways to handle negotiated content similar to Vary . They could bypass cache and let their origin deal with it, reproduce the origin's negotiation logic in a custom cache key or other rule , use a Worker , or use features like Vary for images .
paragraphs.zh: Cloudflare 客户端已经有多种方式来处理类似于 Vary 的协商内容。 他们可以绕过缓存并让源站处理，通过自定义缓存键或其他规则复现源站的协商逻辑，使用 Worker，或使用像图片 Vary 这样的功能。

sents.en: Cloudflare customers already had several ways to handle negotiated content similar to Vary .
sents.zh: Cloudflare 客户端已经有多种方式来处理类似于 Vary 的协商内容。

sents.en: They could bypass cache and let their origin deal with it, reproduce the origin's negotiation logic in a custom cache key or other rule , use a Worker , or use features like Vary for images .
sents.zh: 他们可以绕过缓存并让源站处理，通过自定义缓存键或其他规则复现源站的协商逻辑，使用 Worker，或使用像图片 Vary 这样的功能。

paragraphs.en: Those options remain useful, but they either give up caching, duplicate application logic, need to write additional code, or address a narrower use case. Vary in Cache Rules may fill the gap between these existing features by splitting support into two decisions:
paragraphs.zh: 这些选项仍然有用，但它们要么放弃缓存，要么重复应用逻辑，要么需要编写额外的代码，要么只覆盖较窄的使用场景。 Cache Rules 中的 Vary 或许可以填补这些现有功能之间的空白，它将支持拆分为两个决策：

sents.en: Those options remain useful, but they either give up caching, duplicate application logic, need to write additional code, or address a narrower use case.
sents.zh: 这些选项仍然有用，但它们要么放弃缓存，要么重复应用逻辑，要么需要编写额外的代码，要么只覆盖较窄的使用场景。

sents.en: Vary in Cache Rules may fill the gap between these existing features by splitting support into two decisions:
sents.zh: Cache Rules 中的 Vary 或许可以填补这些现有功能之间的空白，它将支持拆分为两个决策：

paragraphs.en: A Cache Rule does not force every response to vary . If the origin does not return Vary , Cloudflare caches the response normally, though the rule may still rewrite Accept and Accept-Language before forwarding the request to the origin.
paragraphs.zh: 缓存规则不会强制每个响应都发生变化。 如果源站没有返回 Vary，Cloudflare 仍会正常缓存该响应，不过该规则在将请求转发到源站之前，仍可能改写 Accept 和 Accept-Language。

sents.en: A Cache Rule does not force every response to vary .
sents.zh: 缓存规则不会强制每个响应都发生变化。

sents.en: If the origin does not return Vary , Cloudflare caches the response normally, though the rule may still rewrite Accept and Accept-Language before forwarding the request to the origin.
sents.zh: 如果源站没有返回 Vary，Cloudflare 仍会正常缓存该响应，不过该规则在将请求转发到源站之前，仍可能改写 Accept 和 Accept-Language。

sents.zh: 当源站返回 Vary 时，Cloudflare 会对其列出的每个标头应用所配置的操作。

sents.en: Headers without an individual setting use the rule’s default action .
sents.zh: 没有单独设置的标头使用规则的默认操作。

sents.en: The three available actions are:

paragraphs.en: Normalizes request headers before selecting a cached variant, helping equivalent requests share a cached response. Applies header-specific rules to Accept , Accept-Language , and Accept-Encoding . For other headers, it trims optional whitespace and combines repeated header lines in their original order, preserving casing and interior whitespace.
paragraphs.zh: 在选择缓存变体之前对请求头进行规范化，帮助等价请求共享同一缓存响应。 对 Accept、Accept-Language 和 Accept-Encoding 应用特定于请求头的规则。 对于其他请求头，它会去除可选的空白符，并按原始顺序合并重复的请求头行，同时保留大小写和内部空白符。

sents.en: Normalizes request headers before selecting a cached variant, helping equivalent requests share a cached response.
sents.zh: 在选择缓存变体之前对请求头进行规范化，帮助等价请求共享同一缓存响应。

sents.en: Applies header-specific rules to Accept , Accept-Language , and Accept-Encoding .
sents.zh: 对 Accept、Accept-Language 和 Accept-Encoding 应用特定于请求头的规则。

sents.en: For other headers, it trims optional whitespace and combines repeated header lines in their original order, preserving casing and interior whitespace.
sents.zh: 对于其他请求头，它会去除可选的空白符，并按原始顺序合并重复的请求头行，同时保留大小写和内部空白符。

paragraphs.en: The recommended starting point for negotiation headers where many request values map to a small set of responses.
paragraphs.zh: 推荐用于协商头部的起始点，适用于许多请求值映射到少量响应的场景。

paragraphs.en: Uses the request header’s raw bytes for cache matching, preserving casing, whitespace, order, and duplicate values. If the header appears on multiple lines, Cloudflare combines those lines in order using commas for cache matching. Passthrough leaves the outgoing header lines unchanged. Cloudflare can still rewrite Accept-Encoding when Respect Strong ETags is disabled.
paragraphs.zh: 使用请求头的原始字节进行缓存匹配，保留大小写、空格、顺序以及重复的值。 如果该标头出现在多行中，Cloudflare 在缓存匹配时会按顺序将这些行用逗号合并。 透传会保持输出的标头行不变。 当「尊重强 ETag」被禁用时，Cloudflare 仍可重写 Accept-Encoding。

sents.en: Uses the request header’s raw bytes for cache matching, preserving casing, whitespace, order, and duplicate values.

sents.en: Passthrough leaves the outgoing header lines unchanged.

sents.en: Cloudflare can still rewrite Accept-Encoding when Respect Strong ETags is disabled.
sents.zh: 当「尊重强 ETag」被禁用时，Cloudflare 仍可重写 Accept-Encoding。

paragraphs.en: Headers with a controlled set of values, where the exact value changes the response.
paragraphs.zh: 具有一组受控取值的请求头，其具体取值会改变响应。

paragraphs.en: Does not store the response when the origin names that header in Vary . Existing cache entries are not removed, so purge them if they need to be cleared.
paragraphs.zh: 当源服务器在 Vary 中指定该头部时，不存储响应。 不会移除现有的缓存条目，因此如果需要清除它们，请手动清除。

paragraphs.en: Use for personalized, high-cardinality, or unexpected headers such as Cookie or User-Agent .
paragraphs.zh: 用于个性化、高基数值或意外的标头，例如 Cookie 或 User-Agent。

paragraphs.en: We recommend normalize as the default. For individual headers with personal or unbounded values, use bypass . Use passthrough when the exact value changes the response.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推荐将 normalize 作为默认选项。 对于包含个人信息或无边界值的个别标头，请使用 bypass。 当确切的值会影响响应时，请使用 passthrough。

sents.en: For individual headers with personal or unbounded values, use bypass .
sents.zh: 对于包含个人信息或无边界值的个别标头，请使用 bypass。

paragraphs.en: Enough incidental variation can turn a reusable response into many one-off variants in your cache.
paragraphs.zh: 足够多的偶然变化会把缓存中的一条可复用响应变成许多一次性变体。

paragraphs.en: Regardless of the configured actions, Vary: * always bypasses cache. It means any aspect of the request, even information outside the HTTP message (like the client’s IP address), may affect which response the origin selects. Cloudflare therefore cannot reuse the response for a later request without contacting the origin.
paragraphs.zh: 无论配置了何种操作，Vary: * 始终会绕过缓存。 这意味着请求的任何方面，即使是 HTTP 消息之外的信息（例如客户端的 IP 地址），都可能影响源站选择哪个响应。 因此，Cloudflare 在不联系源站的情况下，无法将响应复用于后续请求。

sents.en: Regardless of the configured actions, Vary: * always bypasses cache.
sents.zh: 无论配置了何种操作，Vary: * 始终会绕过缓存。

sents.en: Cloudflare therefore cannot reuse the response for a later request without contacting the origin.
sents.zh: 因此，Cloudflare 在不联系源站的情况下，无法将响应复用于后续请求。

paragraphs.en: Let’s follow one of the /catalog requests from above through Cloudflare.
paragraphs.zh: 让我们跟踪上面其中一个 /catalog 请求在 Cloudflare 中的处理过程。

paragraphs.en: On the first request, Cloudflare has no stored Vary data for the resource, so the cache lookup misses. The matching Cache Rule can normalize configured fields before Cloudflare contacts the origin.
paragraphs.zh: 首次请求时，Cloudflare 尚未存储该资源的 Vary 数据，因此缓存查找未命中。 在 Cloudflare 联系源站之前，匹配的缓存规则可以先对已配置的字段进行规范化。

sents.en: On the first request, Cloudflare has no stored Vary data for the resource, so the cache lookup misses.
sents.zh: 首次请求时，Cloudflare 尚未存储该资源的 Vary 数据，因此缓存查找未命中。

sents.en: The matching Cache Rule can normalize configured fields before Cloudflare contacts the origin.
sents.zh: 在 Cloudflare 联系源站之前，匹配的缓存规则可以先对已配置的字段进行规范化。

paragraphs.en: This can happen before Cloudflare knows whether the eventual response will contain Vary . The Cache Rule defines the permitted normalization; the response later determines whether those fields become part of the cached variant.
paragraphs.zh: 这可能发生在 Cloudflare 尚不知道最终响应是否包含 Vary 之前。 缓存规则定义了允许的规范化；响应稍后决定这些字段是否成为缓存变体的一部分。

sents.en: This can happen before Cloudflare knows whether the eventual response will contain Vary .
sents.zh: 这可能发生在 Cloudflare 尚不知道最终响应是否包含 Vary 之前。

sents.en: The Cache Rule defines the permitted normalization; the response later determines whether those fields become part of the cached variant.
sents.zh: 缓存规则定义了允许的规范化；响应稍后决定这些字段是否成为缓存变体的一部分。

paragraphs.en: That ordering matters. If Cloudflare grouped several raw values under one normalized cache key, but the origin still received those raw values, the origin could produce different responses that the cache would later consider interchangeable. Forwarding the normalized value keeps origin selection aligned with cache matching.
paragraphs.zh: 这个顺序很重要。 如果 Cloudflare 将多个原始值归入同一个规范化缓存键，但源站仍然接收到这些原始值，那么源站可能产生不同的响应，而缓存之后会认为这些响应可以互换。 转发规范化后的值可以让源站选择与缓存匹配保持一致。

sents.en: That ordering matters.
sents.zh: 这个顺序很重要。

sents.en: If Cloudflare grouped several raw values under one normalized cache key, but the origin still received those raw values, the origin could produce different responses that the cache would later consider interchangeable.
sents.zh: 如果 Cloudflare 将多个原始值归入同一个规范化缓存键，但源站仍然接收到这些原始值，那么源站可能产生不同的响应，而缓存之后会认为这些响应可以互换。

sents.en: Forwarding the normalized value keeps origin selection aligned with cache matching.
sents.zh: 转发规范化后的值可以让源站选择与缓存匹配保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Cloudflare records those header names and stores the response as a cached variant. The header values, processed according to the Cache Rule, distinguish this variant from others for the same resource.
paragraphs.zh: Cloudflare 会记录这些标头名称，并将响应存储为一个缓存变体。 根据缓存规则（Cache Rule）处理的标头值，将该变体与同一资源的其他变体区分开来。

sents.en: Cloudflare records those header names and stores the response as a cached variant.
sents.zh: Cloudflare 会记录这些标头名称，并将响应存储为一个缓存变体。

sents.en: The header values, processed according to the Cache Rule, distinguish this variant from others for the same resource.
sents.zh: 根据缓存规则（Cache Rule）处理的标头值，将该变体与同一资源的其他变体区分开来。

paragraphs.en: When another request for /catalog arrives, Cloudflare starts with the resource’s base cache key : generally the URL plus any other configured key fields. It then reads the stored Vary fields and applies the Cache Rule to those headers in the new request to identify the matching cached variant.
paragraphs.zh: 当针对 /catalog 的另一个请求到达时，Cloudflare 从该资源的基础缓存键开始：通常是 URL 加上任何其他已配置的键字段。 然后，它会读取已存储的 Vary 字段，并将缓存规则应用于新请求中的这些标头，以识别匹配的缓存变体。

sents.en: When another request for /catalog arrives, Cloudflare starts with the resource’s base cache key : generally the URL plus any other configured key fields.
sents.zh: 当针对 /catalog 的另一个请求到达时，Cloudflare 从该资源的基础缓存键开始：通常是 URL 加上任何其他已配置的键字段。

sents.en: It then reads the stored Vary fields and applies the Cache Rule to those headers in the new request to identify the matching cached variant.
sents.zh: 然后，它会读取已存储的 Vary 字段，并将缓存规则应用于新请求中的这些标头，以识别匹配的缓存变体。

paragraphs.en: Cloudflare uses those values to look up the matching cached variant directly. It does not compare the request against every stored variant one by one.
paragraphs.zh: Cloudflare 使用这些值直接查找匹配的缓存变体。 它不会将请求与每个已存储的变体逐一进行比较。

sents.en: Cloudflare uses those values to look up the matching cached variant directly.
sents.zh: Cloudflare 使用这些值直接查找匹配的缓存变体。

sents.en: It does not compare the request against every stored variant one by one.
sents.zh: 它不会将请求与每个已存储的变体逐一进行比较。

paragraphs.en: If a matching variant exists and is fresh, the request is a cache hit. If not, Cloudflare sends the request to the origin and may store the resulting response as another variant.
paragraphs.zh: 如果存在匹配的变体且该变体是新鲜的，则该请求为缓存命中。 如果不存在，Cloudflare 会将该请求发送到源站，并可能将生成的响应存储为另一个变体。

sents.en: If a matching variant exists and is fresh, the request is a cache hit.
sents.zh: 如果存在匹配的变体且该变体是新鲜的，则该请求为缓存命中。

sents.en: If not, Cloudflare sends the request to the origin and may store the resulting response as another variant.
sents.zh: 如果不存在，Cloudflare 会将该请求发送到源站，并可能将生成的响应存储为另一个变体。

paragraphs.en: This places an important responsibility on the origin. Every cacheable response that can differ based on request fields must return the appropriate Vary header consistently, including errors and fallback responses. If one response omits it, Cloudflare could cache that response without the variance needed to keep it isolated.
paragraphs.zh: 这对源站提出了重要责任。 每个可能因请求字段不同而有所差异的可缓存响应，都必须始终返回相应的 Vary 头，包括错误响应和回退响应。 如果某个响应省略了该头，Cloudflare 可能会在缺少保持隔离所需差异信息的情况下缓存该响应。

sents.en: This places an important responsibility on the origin.
sents.zh: 这对源站提出了重要责任。

sents.en: Every cacheable response that can differ based on request fields must return the appropriate Vary header consistently, including errors and fallback responses.
sents.zh: 每个可能因请求字段不同而有所差异的可缓存响应，都必须始终返回相应的 Vary 头，包括错误响应和回退响应。

sents.en: If one response omits it, Cloudflare could cache that response without the variance needed to keep it isolated.
sents.zh: 如果某个响应省略了该头，Cloudflare 可能会在缺少保持隔离所需差异信息的情况下缓存该响应。

sents.zh: 后续的请求假定存在一个新鲜的缓存响应。

paragraphs.en: Any purge targeting a cached resource covers all its Vary variants. Existing requirements for purging custom cache keys still apply.
paragraphs.zh: 任何针对缓存资源的清除操作都会覆盖其所有 Vary 变体。 清除自定义缓存键的现有要求仍然适用。

sents.en: Any purge targeting a cached resource covers all its Vary variants.
sents.zh: 任何针对缓存资源的清除操作都会覆盖其所有 Vary 变体。

sents.en: Existing requirements for purging custom cache keys still apply.
sents.zh: 清除自定义缓存键的现有要求仍然适用。

paragraphs.en: Changing a Vary configuration does not automatically purge existing content. The new policy may produce different cache keys: requests can miss and refill under the new keys, while old entries remain until they expire or are purged.
paragraphs.zh: 更改 Vary 配置不会自动清除已有内容。 新策略可能产生不同的缓存键：请求可能未命中并在新键下重新填充，而旧条目会一直保留，直到过期或被清除。

sents.en: Changing a Vary configuration does not automatically purge existing content.
sents.zh: 更改 Vary 配置不会自动清除已有内容。

sents.en: The new policy may produce different cache keys: requests can miss and refill under the new keys, while old entries remain until they expire or are purged.
sents.zh: 新策略可能产生不同的缓存键：请求可能未命中并在新键下重新填充，而旧条目会一直保留，直到过期或被清除。

paragraphs.en: Remember the requests from above asking for English and French?
paragraphs.zh: 还记得上文要求使用英语和法语吗？

paragraphs.en: Both requests prefer English, but passthrough would treat them as different variants. If the Cache Rule allows en , fr , and de , normalize reduces both to en , fr , allowing them to share a cached response.
paragraphs.zh: 两个请求都偏好英语，但直接透传会把它们视为不同的变体。 如果缓存规则允许 en 、 fr 和 de ，归一化会把两者都缩减为 en 、 fr ，从而允许它们共享一个缓存的响应。

sents.en: Both requests prefer English, but passthrough would treat them as different variants.
sents.zh: 两个请求都偏好英语，但直接透传会把它们视为不同的变体。

sents.en: If the Cache Rule allows en , fr , and de , normalize reduces both to en , fr , allowing them to share a cached response.
sents.zh: 如果缓存规则允许 en 、 fr 和 de ，归一化会把两者都缩减为 en 、 fr ，从而允许它们共享一个缓存的响应。

paragraphs.en: To do this, Cloudflare lowercases values in Accept , Accept-Language , and Accept-Encoding , then sorts them by quality value , the highest first, with alphabetical ordering to break ties. The client’s ordering therefore does not affect the cache key. After sorting, Cloudflare strips parameters from entries with a nonzero quality value. It can also lose q=0 (“not acceptable”) when shortening language tags or filtering to the configured formats and languages. For example, en-US;q=0 can become en. Use passthrough for Accept or Accept-Language if the origin needs to see those exclusions.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，Cloudflare 会将 Accept、Accept-Language 和 Accept-Encoding 中的值转换为小写，然后按质量值排序，质量值最高的排在最前，并列时按字母顺序打破平局。 因此，客户端的排序不会影响缓存键。 排序后，Cloudflare 会去掉质量值非零条目中的参数。 在缩短语言标签或按配置的格式和语言进行过滤时，它也可能丢失 q=0（“不可接受”）。 例如，en-US;q=0 可能变成 en。 如果源站需要看到这些排除项，请对 Accept 或 Accept-Language 使用透传。

sents.en: To do this, Cloudflare lowercases values in Accept , Accept-Language , and Accept-Encoding , then sorts them by quality value , the highest first, with alphabetical ordering to break ties.
sents.zh: 为此，Cloudflare 会将 Accept、Accept-Language 和 Accept-Encoding 中的值转换为小写，然后按质量值排序，质量值最高的排在最前，并列时按字母顺序打破平局。

sents.en: The client’s ordering therefore does not affect the cache key.
sents.zh: 因此，客户端的排序不会影响缓存键。

sents.en: After sorting, Cloudflare strips parameters from entries with a nonzero quality value.
sents.zh: 排序后，Cloudflare 会去掉质量值非零条目中的参数。

sents.en: It can also lose q=0 (“not acceptable”) when shortening language tags or filtering to the configured formats and languages.
sents.zh: 在缩短语言标签或按配置的格式和语言进行过滤时，它也可能丢失 q=0（“不可接受”）。

sents.en: For example, en-US;q=0 can become en.
sents.zh: 例如，en-US;q=0 可能变成 en。

sents.en: Use passthrough for Accept or Accept-Language if the origin needs to see those exclusions.
sents.zh: 如果源站需要看到这些排除项，请对 Accept 或 Accept-Language 使用透传。

paragraphs.en: You can also configure the rule to keep only specified media types or languages in Accept and Accept-Language . Regional language tags such as en-US reduce to their base language, en, unless the full tag is configured. This lets you align normalization with the formats and languages your origin actually serves.
paragraphs.zh: 你还可以将规则配置为在 Accept 和 Accept-Language 中仅保留指定的媒体类型或语言。 诸如 en-US 之类的地区语言标签会简化为其基础语言 en，除非配置了完整标签。 这使你能够让规范化与源站实际服务的格式和语言保持一致。

sents.en: You can also configure the rule to keep only specified media types or languages in Accept and Accept-Language .
sents.zh: 你还可以将规则配置为在 Accept 和 Accept-Language 中仅保留指定的媒体类型或语言。

sents.en: Regional language tags such as en-US reduce to their base language, en, unless the full tag is configured.
sents.zh: 诸如 en-US 之类的地区语言标签会简化为其基础语言 en，除非配置了完整标签。

sents.en: This lets you align normalization with the formats and languages your origin actually serves.
sents.zh: 这使你能够让规范化与源站实际服务的格式和语言保持一致。

paragraphs.en: To keep origin selection aligned with cache matching, Cloudflare forwards the normalized Accept and Accept-Language values to the origin. It also forwards normalized Accept-Encoding values when Respect Strong ETags is enabled. Other headers are normalized only for cache matching.
paragraphs.zh: 为了使源站选择与缓存匹配保持一致，Cloudflare 会将规范化后的 Accept 和 Accept-Language 值转发到源站。 当启用“尊重强 ETag”（Respect Strong ETags）时，它还会转发规范化后的 Accept-Encoding 值。 其他标头仅针对缓存匹配进行规范化。

sents.en: To keep origin selection aligned with cache matching, Cloudflare forwards the normalized Accept and Accept-Language values to the origin.
sents.zh: 为了使源站选择与缓存匹配保持一致，Cloudflare 会将规范化后的 Accept 和 Accept-Language 值转发到源站。

sents.en: It also forwards normalized Accept-Encoding values when Respect Strong ETags is enabled.
sents.zh: 当启用“尊重强 ETag”（Respect Strong ETags）时，它还会转发规范化后的 Accept-Encoding 值。

sents.en: Other headers are normalized only for cache matching.
sents.zh: 其他标头仅针对缓存匹配进行规范化。

paragraphs.en: In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to Caching > Cache Rules , create or edit a rule, make the response eligible for cache, and add the Vary setting. Set the default behavior, then add the headers your origin is expected to name.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Cloudflare 控制面板中，前往 Caching > Cache Rules（缓存 > 缓存规则），创建或编辑一条规则，使响应符合缓存条件，然后添加 Vary（变化）设置。 设置默认行为，然后添加源站预期指定的标头。

sents.en: In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to Caching > Cache Rules , create or edit a rule, make the response eligible for cache, and add the Vary setting.
sents.zh: 在 Cloudflare 控制面板中，前往 Caching > Cache Rules（缓存 > 缓存规则），创建或编辑一条规则，使响应符合缓存条件，然后添加 Vary（变化）设置。

sents.en: Set the default behavior, then add the headers your origin is expected to name.
sents.zh: 设置默认行为，然后添加源站预期指定的标头。

paragraphs.en: The same configuration is available through the Rulesets API in the http_request_cache_settings phase. The default setting chooses a fallback action for headers your origin names in Vary that you have not configured individually.
paragraphs.zh: 可通过 Rulesets API 的 http_request_cache_settings 阶段使用相同的配置。 默认设置为源站在 Vary 中命名但你未单独配置的标头选择一个回退操作。

sents.en: The same configuration is available through the Rulesets API in the http_request_cache_settings phase.
sents.zh: 可通过 Rulesets API 的 http_request_cache_settings 阶段使用相同的配置。

sents.en: The default setting chooses a fallback action for headers your origin names in Vary that you have not configured individually.
sents.zh: 默认设置为源站在 Vary 中命名但你未单独配置的标头选择一个回退操作。

paragraphs.en: This example normalizes Accept and Accept-Language to a configured set of formats and languages. The default normalize action also applies to other headers named in Vary :
paragraphs.zh: 本示例将 Accept 和 Accept-Language 规范化为所配置的一组格式和语言。 默认的规范化操作也适用于 Vary 中列出的其他头部：

sents.en: This example normalizes Accept and Accept-Language to a configured set of formats and languages.
sents.zh: 本示例将 Accept 和 Accept-Language 规范化为所配置的一组格式和语言。

sents.en: The default normalize action also applies to other headers named in Vary :
sents.zh: 默认的规范化操作也适用于 Vary 中列出的其他头部：

paragraphs.en: { "rules": [ { "ref": "vary_negotiated_content", "description": "Cache bounded negotiated representations", "expression": "(http.host eq \"example.com\" and http.request.uri.path eq \"/catalog\")", "action": "set_cache_settings", "action_parameters": { "cache": true, "vary": { "default": { "action": "normalize" }, "headers": { "accept": { "action": "normalize", "media_types": ["text/html", "application/json"] }, "accept-language": { "action": "normalize", "languages": ["en", "fr", "de"] } } } } } ] } This is a complete request body for a PUT to the http_request_cache_settings phase entrypoint. A PUT replaces every rule in that entrypoint. If you already have Cache Rules, include them in the rules array or use the appropriate single-rule create or update operation instead.
paragraphs.zh: { "rules": [ { "ref": "vary_negotiated_content", "description": "缓存有边界的协商表示", "expression": "(http.host eq \"example.com\" and http.request.uri.path eq \"/catalog\")", "action": "set_cache_settings", "action_parameters": { "cache": true, "vary": { "default": { "action": "normalize" }, "headers": { "accept": { "action": "normalize", "media_types": ["text/html", "application/json"] }, "accept-language": { "action": "normalize", "languages": ["en", "fr", "de"] } } } } } ] } 这是一个用于对 http_request_cache_settings 阶段入口点执行 PUT 请求的完整请求体。 一次 PUT 会替换该入口点中的所有规则。 如果您已有缓存规则，请将它们包含在 rules 数组中，或者改用相应的单条规则创建或更新操作。

sents.en: { "rules": [ { "ref": "vary_negotiated_content", "description": "Cache bounded negotiated representations", "expression": "(http.host eq \"example.com\" and http.request.uri.path eq \"/catalog\")", "action": "set_cache_settings", "action_parameters": { "cache": true, "vary": { "default": { "action": "normalize" }, "headers": { "accept": { "action": "normalize", "media_types": ["text/html", "application/json"] }, "accept-language": { "action": "normalize", "languages": ["en", "fr", "de"] } } } } } ] } This is a complete request body for a PUT to the http_request_cache_settings phase entrypoint.
sents.zh: { "rules": [ { "ref": "vary_negotiated_content", "description": "缓存有边界的协商表示", "expression": "(http.host eq \"example.com\" and http.request.uri.path eq \"/catalog\")", "action": "set_cache_settings", "action_parameters": { "cache": true, "vary": { "default": { "action": "normalize" }, "headers": { "accept": { "action": "normalize", "media_types": ["text/html", "application/json"] }, "accept-language": { "action": "normalize", "languages": ["en", "fr", "de"] } } } } } ] } 这是一个用于对 http_request_cache_settings 阶段入口点执行 PUT 请求的完整请求体。

sents.en: A PUT replaces every rule in that entrypoint.
sents.zh: 一次 PUT 会替换该入口点中的所有规则。

sents.en: If you already have Cache Rules, include them in the rules array or use the appropriate single-rule create or update operation instead.
sents.zh: 如果您已有缓存规则，请将它们包含在 rules 数组中，或者改用相应的单条规则创建或更新操作。

paragraphs.en: If the origin serves one representation for each media type and language pair, there are six content combinations. That does not cap the cache at six keys. Preference order, missing headers, and values that normalize to empty can create more. Keep the supported set small and define the rule’s boundaries clearly. After rollout, test the same URL with different header values that should normalize to the same cached variant. Send the test requests from the same client, confirm they return the expected format and language, and inspect CF-Cache-Status . Look for hits once the cache is populated, and investigate persistent miss responses or unexpected bypass responses.
paragraphs.zh: 如果源站为每种媒体类型和语言对提供一种表示形式，则会有六种内容组合。 这并不意味着缓存上限就是六个键。 偏好顺序、缺失的请求头以及会规范化为空值的取值，都可能产生更多的键。 保持受支持集合较小，并清晰地定义该规则的边界。 上线后，使用不同但应规范化为同一缓存变体的请求头取值来测试同一 URL。 从同一客户端发送测试请求，确认它们返回预期的格式和语言，并检查 CF-Cache-Status。 缓存被填充后应寻找命中，并对持续的未命中响应或意外的绕过响应进行调查。

sents.en: If the origin serves one representation for each media type and language pair, there are six content combinations.
sents.zh: 如果源站为每种媒体类型和语言对提供一种表示形式，则会有六种内容组合。

sents.en: That does not cap the cache at six keys.
sents.zh: 这并不意味着缓存上限就是六个键。

sents.en: Preference order, missing headers, and values that normalize to empty can create more.
sents.zh: 偏好顺序、缺失的请求头以及会规范化为空值的取值，都可能产生更多的键。

sents.en: Keep the supported set small and define the rule’s boundaries clearly.
sents.zh: 保持受支持集合较小，并清晰地定义该规则的边界。

sents.en: After rollout, test the same URL with different header values that should normalize to the same cached variant.
sents.zh: 上线后，使用不同但应规范化为同一缓存变体的请求头取值来测试同一 URL。

sents.en: Send the test requests from the same client, confirm they return the expected format and language, and inspect CF-Cache-Status .
sents.zh: 从同一客户端发送测试请求，确认它们返回预期的格式和语言，并检查 CF-Cache-Status。

sents.en: Look for hits once the cache is populated, and investigate persistent miss responses or unexpected bypass responses.
sents.zh: 缓存被填充后应寻找命中，并对持续的未命中响应或意外的绕过响应进行调查。

paragraphs.en: For limitations, additional examples, and how to set this in Terraform, see the Vary documentation .
paragraphs.zh: 有关限制、更多示例以及如何在 Terraform 中进行设置，请参阅 Vary 文档。

paragraphs.en: At this point, an obvious question is, “why not add Accept and Accept-Language to a custom cache key ?”
paragraphs.zh: 此时，一个显而易见的问题是：“为什么不把 Accept 和 Accept-Language 添加到自定义缓存键中呢？”

paragraphs.en: That works when those fields are always part of the resource’s identity. But a custom cache key adds the configured dimensions to every response covered by the rule, whether the origin used them or not.
paragraphs.zh: 当这些字段始终是资源标识的一部分时，这种方式是有效的。 但自定义缓存键会将已配置的维度添加到该规则覆盖的每个响应中，无论源服务器是否使用了它们。

sents.en: That works when those fields are always part of the resource’s identity.
sents.zh: 当这些字段始终是资源标识的一部分时，这种方式是有效的。

sents.en: But a custom cache key adds the configured dimensions to every response covered by the rule, whether the origin used them or not.
sents.zh: 但自定义缓存键会将已配置的维度添加到该规则覆盖的每个响应中，无论源服务器是否使用了它们。

paragraphs.en: Vary is response-driven, but cacheable responses under the same base key need a consistent set of Vary fields.
paragraphs.zh: Vary 是基于响应驱动的，但在同一基础键下可缓存的响应需要一组一致的 Vary 字段。

paragraphs.en: Use a custom cache key when a request property always defines the resource. Use Vary when the origin declares the same set of request fields across cacheable responses. Avoid placing the same header in both unless the duplication is deliberate and tested.
paragraphs.zh: 当某个请求属性总是定义了该资源时，使用自定义缓存键。 当源服务器在可缓存的响应中声明了同一组请求字段时，使用 Vary。 除非重复是有意为之且经过测试，否则避免在两者中放置相同的请求头。

sents.en: Use a custom cache key when a request property always defines the resource.
sents.zh: 当某个请求属性总是定义了该资源时，使用自定义缓存键。

sents.en: Use Vary when the origin declares the same set of request fields across cacheable responses.
sents.zh: 当源服务器在可缓存的响应中声明了同一组请求字段时，使用 Vary。

sents.en: Avoid placing the same header in both unless the duplication is deliberate and tested.
sents.zh: 除非重复是有意为之且经过测试，否则避免在两者中放置相同的请求头。

paragraphs.en: Vary helps solve an obvious problem: one URL can have more than one correct response. But it hands a cache a harder problem, which request differences actually matter? The origin knows which responses it can serve. The cache needs to know which requests can reuse each response.
paragraphs.zh: Vary 有助于解决一个显而易见的问题：同一个 URL 可能对应多个正确的响应。 但它也给缓存带来了一个更难的问题：哪些请求差异是真正重要的？ 源服务器知道自己能提供哪些响应。 缓存则需要知道哪些请求可以复用每个响应。

sents.en: Vary helps solve an obvious problem: one URL can have more than one correct response.
sents.zh: Vary 有助于解决一个显而易见的问题：同一个 URL 可能对应多个正确的响应。

sents.en: But it hands a cache a harder problem, which request differences actually matter?
sents.zh: 但它也给缓存带来了一个更难的问题：哪些请求差异是真正重要的？

sents.en: The origin knows which responses it can serve.
sents.zh: 源服务器知道自己能提供哪些响应。

sents.en: The cache needs to know which requests can reuse each response.
sents.zh: 缓存则需要知道哪些请求可以复用每个响应。

paragraphs.en: Vary in Cache Rules connects those two views. The origin identifies the request fields that may affect a response. You decide whether to normalize values, use passthrough for exact differences, or keep the response out of cache.
paragraphs.zh: Cache Rules 中的 Vary 将这两个视图关联起来。 源站用于标识可能影响响应的请求字段。 由你决定是规范化这些值、使用透传来保留精确差异，还是将该响应排除在缓存之外。

sents.en: Vary in Cache Rules connects those two views.
sents.zh: Cache Rules 中的 Vary 将这两个视图关联起来。

sents.en: The origin identifies the request fields that may affect a response.
sents.zh: 源站用于标识可能影响响应的请求字段。

sents.en: You decide whether to normalize values, use passthrough for exact differences, or keep the response out of cache.
sents.zh: 由你决定是规范化这些值、使用透传来保留精确差异，还是将该响应排除在缓存之外。

paragraphs.en: Vary was never too ugly to be useful. But configuring supported formats and languages manually may not suit every application. We’re evaluating whether ideas from the expired Availability Hints draft could reduce that work by letting origins describe the representations they serve directly.
paragraphs.zh: Vary 从来都不是丑到不可用。 但手动配置支持的格式和语言可能并不适合每个应用程序。 我们正在评估，已过期的 Availability Hints 草案中的想法是否能让源站直接描述其所提供的表示形式，从而减少这项工作。

sents.zh: Vary 从来都不是丑到不可用。

sents.en: But configuring supported formats and languages manually may not suit every application.
sents.zh: 但手动配置支持的格式和语言可能并不适合每个应用程序。

sents.en: We’re evaluating whether ideas from the expired Availability Hints draft could reduce that work by letting origins describe the representations they serve directly.
sents.zh: 我们正在评估，已过期的 Availability Hints 草案中的想法是否能让源站直接描述其所提供的表示形式，从而减少这项工作。

paragraphs.en: Vary in Cache Rules is available today on Free, Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans through the Cloudflare dashboard , Rulesets API , and Terraform .
paragraphs.zh: Cache Rules 中的 Vary 功能现已在 Free、Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 计划中推出，可通过 Cloudflare 控制面板、Rulesets API 和 Terraform 使用。
